title: Grouping with tests and ranking in suppliers

steps.title: city with at least 1 rows
steps.prompt:
HAVING can hold any test about the piles.
Here we keep only piles with count(*) >= 1.
steps.task: Try typing: SELECT city, count(*) FROM suppliers GROUP BY city HAVING count(*) >= 1;
hints: Write: SELECT city, count(*) FROM suppliers GROUP BY city HAVING count(*) >= 1;
steps.expected_sql: SELECT city, count(*) FROM suppliers GROUP BY city HAVING count(*) >= 1;
